claim: With a back buffer, place hardware sprites by the displayed frame (after the visible copy), and keep a figure's last displayed image when a partial copy misses it.

evidence.text: Commit C7D2 is after the three visible copies; C3CB is too early for a displayed position.
evidence.quote: Commit C7D2 is after the three visible copies; C3CB is too early for a displayed position.

evidence.text: A copy that misses a newly positioned figure retains the previous visible sprite instead of hiding it; the original ULA retains that image too.
evidence.quote: copy that misses a newly positioned figure retains the previous visible sprite instead of hiding
